method: Official Impeccable 4.8.0 source detector plus official audit.md; current source and baseline diff, no browser, images, previous assessments, fixer reports or design transcript.

detectorFindings.reason: All three overused-font warnings are Geist font/import hits in src/index.css; Geist/Hind Siliguri are explicitly approved by taste T1 and the brief. No font substitution is authorized.

scoreNotes.accessibility: Labels, serial/vendor connected errors, named close controls, keyboard radios, scroll-region focus, IME protection and reduced-motion handling are present. Source-only audit does not certify every WCAG contrast/zoom/focus state.
scoreNotes.performance: Bounded eight-result picker, popup-only scroll adjustment, measured position equality guard and cleaned-up observers/listeners. No new asset/library or expensive animation was introduced; no runtime profiling was performed.
scoreNotes.responsive: Phone stacked rows and full product names, tablet one-line rows, desktop grid budget, opt-in joined quantity scrolling and complete-sale wrapping are explicit. Source alone does not certify all rendered zoom/gesture cases.
scoreNotes.theming: Changed surfaces retain semantic HisabIQ ink/teal/border/card/warning/danger tokens and shared field/button primitives; no verified new dark-theme drift.
scoreNotes.integrity: Business paths and shared defaults are preserved; remaining incomplete POS presentation translation is isolated and nonfinancial.

problems.classification: pre-existing in-scope gap; partially improved, not introduced regression
problems.evidence: T9/T10. InstallmentReceivePaymentDialog.tsx:63-71 forwards validateInstallmentCollection messages and :161 renders them through posPresentationError. In Bangla, entering a valid positive receipt/split, expanding manual allocation and leaving all allocations blank reaches "Choose an installment allocation." (validateCollection.ts:23), absent from errorBangla and returned unchanged at presentationCopy.ts:47. "Choose a valid payment date, not in the future." is also unmapped. An in-memory TypeScript transpilation/pure-function probe verified both remain English even when the translation callback selects Bangla. This is source/pure-function evidence, not a new browser claim.
problems.impact: A Bangla operator receives English-only correction guidance in the installment collection dialog, although surrounding controls follow the chosen language.
problems.fix: Record as remaining closing-check limitation. A separately authorized follow-up can complete the presentation-only mapping for reachable collection errors without editing domain validation or stored values.

resolvedSourceChecks.result: Serial scan/paste use connected labels, aria-invalid/description and alert; serial remove has translated name and shared 36px Button. Vendor cost connects its label, hint and invalid alert.
InstallmentTermsPanel adjustment mode uses shared FormSelect (it renders AppSelect), not an ad-hoc native select.
SortableCartRow uses useReducedMotion, initial false, noncollapsing exit and zero duration/layout duration; pointer reorder and keyboard order remain.
POS CartTable opts into composition guards and popup-only active-option scrolling; CustomerPicker checkout opts into IME safety.

ProductCombobox localizeMetadata=false and posKeyboardSafety=false; CustomerPicker guardComposition=false; MultiUnitQuantityInput readableValues=false. Dialog closeLabel and TransactionReviewDialog amountLanguage/closeLabel are optional. Existing non-opt-in consumers retain their defaults.

Pos supplies source invoice date when editing and businessToday for a new sale to CheckoutPanel.dateLabel. InstallmentAgreementPreview formats displayed schedule/receipt dates. No source/record date writes changed.

Desktop grid and sale total cell rules preserve compact container-local scrolling; phone names and total cells have dedicated rules. Shared index.css:784-809 enforces 13/12/11 roles, so superseded legacy text classes are not reported as drift.

businessPreservation.result: No verified business-behavior regression in the baseline diff.
evidence: No changes under src/hooks, src/installments, src/data, src/utils or src/settings.

Stock choice/save callbacks, serial eligibility/required counts, installment values and source codes, review confirmation callbacks and receipt/invoice navigation remain. Changed strings are rendered presentation only.
Shared options translate labels while retaining original payment account values. DateLabel is read-only presentation.
Existing preview-only disclosures are retained; no new posting claims or fake mutations were introduced.

outOfScopeNotes: Legacy preview posting, installment domain rules and print document language are not financial or backend changes authorized by this UI refinement. No new business defect is asserted.
SaleTemplateDialog retains its pre-existing shared default close-button copy; this is not a changed shared default or new regression.
evidenceLimits: No screenshots, browser or physical touch review was performed in this isolated detector assessment. Rendered responsive/contrast/header-capture conclusions belong to the independent visual/browser reviewers.
Coordinator reports all five gates and fourteen browser suites green at this commit; this agent did not rerun or independently certify those suites.
Only supplied stable ledger totals used: C1=26, C2=28, C3=28.
summary: Official detector produced only three approved-font false positives. The closing source audit found no new business/shared-default regression and one verified remaining Bangla error-copy gap in an expanded POS subsection; no further fix round was performed.
